name: CoverImage
description: A featured image that covers the width of its container, with optional parallax effect; ideal for banners and similar

context.description: The kebab-case or BEM name of the parent component or variant if contextually relevant. May be automatically set by parent component(s).

isParallax.description: In relevant contexts, whether the image should be used to achieve a parallax effect (requires CSS to actually execute)

tagName.description: The HTML tag to use for this component

testId.description: Optionally add a data-testid attribute for automated tests
